commands.command:
set -eu
target=/srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication/bin/replay
tmp=/tmp/replay.$$
cat > "$tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_REPLAY_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

umask 022
base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
lock=$base/.replay.lock

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"
if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' "replay: another recovery is already running" >&2
    exit 1
fi
trap 'rmdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null || :' EXIT HUP INT TERM

if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    index_tmp=$delivered/.index.$$.tmp
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$index_tmp"
    mv -f "$index_tmp" "$index"
fi

message_id_from_file()
{
    awk '
        function finish_id() {
            if (collecting) {
                ids[++count] = value
                collecting = 0
                value = ""
            }
        }
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)

            if (line == "") {
                finish_id()
                exit
            }

            if (line ~ /^[ \t]/) {
                if (collecting) {
                    sub(/^[ \t]+/, "", line)
                    value = value " " line
                }
                next
            }

            finish_id()
            colon = index(line, ":")
            if (colon == 0)
                next

            name = tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1))
            gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", name)
            if (name == "message-id") {
                value = substr(line, colon + 1)
                gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", value)
                collecting = 1
            }
        }
        END {
            finish_id()
            if (count == 0)
                exit 2
            if (count > 1)
                exit 3

            id = ids[1]
            gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", id)
            if (id !~ /^<[^<> \t]+>$/)
                exit 4
            print id
        }
    ' "$1"
}

is_recorded()
{
    awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$1" 'NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1; exit } END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }' "$index"
}

quarantine_message()
{
    source=$1
    explanation=$2
    name=${source##*/}
    cp -p "$source" "$quarantine/$name"
    printf '%s: %s\n' "$name" "$explanation" > "$quarantine/$name.reason"
    printf 'quarantined\t%s\t%s\n' "$name" "$explanation"
}

found=0
for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    found=1

    if message_id=$(message_id_from_file "$message"); then
        :
    else
        status=$?
        case $status in
            2) quarantine_message "$message" "missing Message-ID header" ;;
            3) quarantine_message "$message" "multiple Message-ID headers" ;;
            4) quarantine_message "$message" "invalid Message-ID header" ;;
            *) printf 'replay: could not inspect %s\n' "$message" >&2; exit "$status" ;;
        esac
        continue
    fi

    if is_recorded "$message_id"; then
        printf 'skipped\t%s\t%s\n' "${message##*/}" "$message_id"
        continue
    fi

    source_name=${message##*/}
    destination_name=$source_name
    stem=${source_name%.eml}
    suffix=0
    while [ -e "$delivered/$destination_name" ]; do
        suffix=$((suffix + 1))
        destination_name=$stem.recovered.$suffix.eml
    done

    copy_tmp=$delivered/.replay.$$.${suffix}.tmp
    cp -p "$message" "$copy_tmp"
    mv -f "$copy_tmp" "$delivered/$destination_name"
    printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$destination_name" >> "$index"
    printf 'delivered\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$source_name" "$message_id" "$destination_name"
done

if [ "$found" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "replay: no .eml files found in $spool"
fi
ANTRIEB_REPLAY_EOF
/bin/sh -n "$tmp"
chmod 0755 "$tmp"
cp -p "$target" "$target.pre-repair"
install -m 0755 "$tmp" "$target"
rm -f "$tmp"
/bin/sh -n "$target"
ls -l "$target" "$target.pre-repair"
